title: Guru Purnima
intro: A verse from the Bhagavad Gita on learning from the wise, for Guru Purnima.

posts.caption: For many, today is Guru Purnima, the full moon of Ashadha, when teachers are honoured. It is also called Vyasa Purnima, after the sage Vyasa, traditionally the compiler of the Vedas and author of the Mahabharata, which contains the Gita. Here Krishna tells Arjuna that wisdom is learned from those who have seen the truth, approached with reverence (pranipata), sincere questioning and service (seva). It is often cited as a classic statement of the bond between guru and student.
